race.comment: I AM A WINNER (3) is the obvious danger after a Class 3 win at Ipswich and a narrow Gatton second, with a solid 800m record and the winning rider staying aboard. Finds a suitable assignment and can salute again. BETTERINDANUDE (7) went close in a BM55 at Esk and is proven at this track and distance. Can compete for a place. ZANDARI (13) Gatton Mdn winner third-up and already effective around 800m. Can give this a shake. BAD FOREST (5) had excuses fresh last start and has won 2/2 on the going. Fitter and in the mix. SWEET HESITATION (1) got a long way back last start when 7 lengths away in fifth over 1110m at Toowoomba. Finds a nice race and can play a significant role.
